Game Overview

Wood Tower is a arcade title where enter a world where precision and balance reign supreme as you build towering structures using distinctively shaped wooden blocks. Wood Tower invites you to test your strategic skills and steady hands, offering captivating visuals and challenging gameplay that steadily escalate with each successful placement.
